newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yaohan Japan sees no problem with CB redemption.
newsitem.headline: Yaohan Japan sees no problem with CB redemption.

text.p: Yaohan Japan Corp said on Friday that it did not see a problem with its redemption of convertible bonds (CBs) later this month.
"There is no problem with the redemption of CBs as we will use cash-in-hand, inventories and loans," a company spokesman said.
He did not elaborate on the amount of funds for the redemption.
Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Friday that Yaohan was asking banks for fresh loans as it was likely to be short of funds for the redemption by five to six billion yen.
The paper quoted one large bank as saying that Yaohan had already secured funds for the redemption.
Yaohan may also consider selling securities to raise the redemption funds.
Yaohan said in February that it would sell 16 of its outlets to a supermarket unit of Daiei Inc for 33 billion yen, adding that the funds from the sale would be used for bond redemption in May.
The paper said, however, that Yaohan had to use most of the funds from the sale to repay its debts.
